title: Love the vibe, but a weird bug is breaking the experience
body:
I honestly love the way this app looks and feels. The content delivery is super refreshing and feels much more 'human' than other habit trackers I've tried. The design actually makes me want to push myself and do more, which is rare.
But, I had to cancel my subscription because of one main issue. Since the app is built around daily reflection and tasks, the timing is everything. For some reason, around midday, the app automatically skips to the next day. It completely messes up my flow and makes it impossible to track my progress properly.
I know these things are fixable, but it really killed my motivation to keep using it for now. Hopefully, you guys can get this sorted soon because the potential is definitely there. Good luck!
author: Snir.
